introduction: Specification 13 adds the sandbox foundation: a host-side `sandbox` API whose `Sandbox.Tools` returns proxy tools that are drop-in replacements for `tools.All`. Every call runs in an `agentkit-sandboxd` agent reached over the `agentkit.sandbox.v1` gRPC protocol. The spec also covers tar transfer into and out of the sandbox's one workspace, and `local`, an in-process provider with no isolation that exists for tests.

glossary.agent: The AgentKit process inside a sandbox (sandbox/internal/agent, wrapped by the agentkit-sandboxd command) that serves the agentkit.sandbox.v1 Agent service and runs the built-in tools against the workspace.
glossary.definition digest: The SHA-256 over a tool's name, description, input and output schema JSON, prompt guidelines, Builtin flag and execution mode. The host and the agent compute it with one shared function so that each can detect a definition mismatch.
glossary.deliberate refusal: An RPC error with status InvalidArgument, FailedPrecondition, NotFound or Unimplemented. The agent returns it on purpose, and it does not mark the sandbox unavailable.
glossary.effective spec: The Spec returned by Sandbox.Spec(): the caller's Spec after CheckSpec has applied its defaults, with Workdir set to the workspace root the agent reported in Hello.
glossary.entry rules: The single tar-entry validation function used both when the agent extracts a synced tar and when the host validates an exported tar.
glossary.local provider: local.Unisolated(), a sandbox.Provider that runs the agent service in the embedder's own process over os.Pipe pairs with no isolation; it exists for tests and development.
glossary.proxy tool: A core.Tool whose definition fields are copied from the host's tools.All value and whose Execute sends the call to the agent over the Call RPC.
glossary.sandbox: An ephemeral execution environment created by a sandbox.Provider that holds exactly one workspace and one agent process; represented on the host by the sandbox.Sandbox interface.
glossary.sandbox state: The lifecycle of a sandbox: live, then unavailable (after a transport failure, when the agent ends, or at the TTL), then closed (after Close).
glossary.transport failure: While the host context is still live, either an RPC error whose gRPC status is not one of the agent's deliberate refusals (InvalidArgument, FailedPrecondition, NotFound, Unimplemented), or a malformed response. It moves the sandbox to the unavailable state for good.

requirements.title: Agent protocol and generated code
requirements.rationale: One versioned gRPC protocol whose generated code is checked in keeps `go build` free of generators, and lets the tool schemas come from the tools package byte for byte.

criteria.action: declare package agentkit.sandbox.v1 with a go_package naming sandbox/internal/sandboxpb and a single service Agent with exactly five RPCs: unary Hello, Tools and Call, client-streaming SyncTar(stream TarChunk) returning SyncResponse, and server-streaming ExportTar(ExportRequest) returning stream TarChunk. Tool input, result data and result metadata are carried as JSON bytes fields, never as proto structs
keep the protoc-gen-go and protoc-gen-go-grpc output checked in beside sandbox.proto, so that `go build ./...` and `go test ./...` succeed with no protoc and no protoc plugin on PATH

criteria.condition: a developer runs `make proto` with protoc on PATH
criteria.action: install protoc-gen-go v1.36.11 and protoc-gen-go-grpc v1.5.1 into build/bin with `go install`, regenerate the Go code beside sandbox.proto with protoc and those plugins, and write the SHA-256 of sandbox.proto into a checked-in file next to it
criteria.contract: exit status 0; the generated .pb.go and _grpc.pb.go files and the hash file are rewritten

criteria.condition: `make proto` runs and protoc is not on PATH
criteria.action: stop before generating anything and report the missing tool by name
criteria.contract: non-zero exit status; the error output contains the word `protoc`; no checked-in file is modified

criteria.condition: the SHA-256 of the current sandbox.proto differs from the hash recorded in the checked-in hash file
criteria.action: fail offline without invoking any generator
criteria.contract: the test fails with a message that tells the developer to run `make proto`

criteria.action: export ProtocolMajor = 1, ProtocolMinor = 0 and MaxMessageBytes = 16 MiB (16<<20, equal to wire.Defaults().MaxMessageBytes), set MaxMessageBytes as both the send and the receive message limit on the gRPC server in the agent and on the gRPC client on the host, and send tar data in TarChunk messages of at most 1 MiB of data each

make CallRequest carry the tool name and the JSON input bytes, and CallResponse carry ok, JSON data bytes, error, detail, JSON metadata bytes and text, so that one CallRequest and its CallResponse hold everything a single tool call needs and reference no other message or session state

requirements.title: Host API and spec checking
requirements.rationale: Driving every refusal from one function over the provider's Capabilities means that what a provider advertises and what it refuses cannot drift apart.

criteria.action: export AgentPath = "/usr/local/libexec/agentkit-sandboxd"; Spec{Image, Workdir, Env map[string]string, Resources, Network, TTL, Labels, Provider map[string]any}; Resources{CPUs, MemoryBytes, PIDs, DiskBytes}; Network{Mode NetworkMode, Allow []Endpoint} with Endpoint{Host, Port}, and NetworkNone (the zero value), NetworkAllowlist and NetworkUnrestricted; Capabilities{Provider, Isolation, Network, Resources, Image, Workdir, Notes} with IsolationNone, IsolationConfinement, IsolationContainer and IsolationMicroVM; the Provider interface (Capabilities, Create, Reap); the Sandbox interface (ID, Spec, Agent, Sync, Tools, Export, Close); AgentInfo{Version, ProtocolMajor, ProtocolMinor, Workdir, OutlineBackend, Git}; ToolOptions{Symbols tools.SymbolOptions, SpillDir, DisableSpill}; the sealed Source and Destination interfaces, implemented only by Tar{R io.Reader, Path string, Replace bool} and TarOut{W io.Writer}; SyncResult{Files int, Bytes int64}; and the errors ErrUnsupported, ErrProtocol, ErrUnavailable, ErrClosed, ErrToolMismatch, ErrToolsConfigured and ErrUnsafeArchive

criteria.condition: CheckSpec(caps, spec) accepts a spec
criteria.action: return the spec with a TTL of 0 replaced by 1 hour and, only when caps.Workdir is true and spec.Workdir is empty, Workdir set to /workspace. Every other field is returned unchanged
criteria.contract: returns (effective Spec, nil)

criteria.condition: the spec sets a field that caps does not cover: a Network.Mode not listed in caps.Network, a non-zero Resources field that caps cannot bound, a non-empty Image when caps.Image is false, or a non-empty Workdir when caps.Workdir is false
criteria.action: refuse the spec
criteria.contract: returns a zero Spec and a *SpecError{Provider, Field, Reason} for which errors.Is(err, ErrUnsupported) is true, with a message of the form `sandbox: provider "local" cannot honour Spec.Network.Mode = none: <reason>`

criteria.condition: the spec has a negative TTL, a negative Resources value, an Env name that is empty or contains '=' or NUL, an Env value that contains NUL, a Labels key equal to the reserved `agentkit.sandbox`, a non-empty Network.Allow with a mode other than NetworkAllowlist, or an Endpoint with an empty Host or a Port outside 1–65535
criteria.action: refuse the spec whatever capabilities are passed
criteria.contract: returns a zero Spec and a non-nil error whose message names the offending Spec field

criteria.condition: Spec.Provider contains a key that the provider does not define
criteria.action: refuse the spec in Create
criteria.contract: Create returns a nil Sandbox and a non-nil error whose message names the unknown key; no sandbox resources are allocated

criteria.action: call CheckSpec with its own Capabilities as the first step of Create, before allocating any directory, process or connection, so that a refused spec leaves nothing behind

for any Capabilities value and any Spec that passes the provider-independent checks of 13-REQ-2.4, return an error matching ErrUnsupported exactly when the Spec sets at least one field that the Capabilities do not cover

requirements.title: Agent service
requirements.rationale: The agent is where the tools actually run, so it must build them from an explicit environment, honour cancellation, and keep its tool set fresh after a sync.

criteria.condition: the agent is constructed with a workspace path that does not exist or is not a directory
criteria.action: refuse to start
criteria.contract: the constructor returns a non-nil error naming the path and serves nothing

criteria.condition: the host sends a Hello RPC
criteria.action: answer with ProtocolMajor and ProtocolMinor; the module version from runtime/debug build info, or `(devel)` when there is none; the workspace root with symlinks resolved; the outline backend for non-Go files, which is `tree-sitter` in a cgo build and `none` otherwise; and whether `git` resolves on the PATH of the agent's explicit environment
criteria.contract: HelloResponse carrying those five facts

criteria.condition: the host sends the first Tools RPC
criteria.action: build tools.All over the workspace with Env set to the agent's explicit environment (never the process's own), Ignore set to tools.NoGlobalExcludes(), Symbols, SpillDir and DisableSpill from the request, and no Index. An empty SpillDir defaults to `<TMPDIR of the explicit environment>/agentkit-spill`, not os.TempDir()
criteria.contract: ToolsResponse listing each tool's name and definition digest in tools.All order

criteria.condition: a Tools request carries a SpillDir that is non-empty and not absolute, or a Tools RPC arrives after an earlier successful one with different options
criteria.action: refuse the request and leave the configured tool set unchanged; a repeated Tools RPC with identical options returns the same names and digests as the first
criteria.contract: gRPC status InvalidArgument for the relative SpillDir; gRPC status FailedPrecondition for differing options

criteria.condition: the host sends a Call RPC naming a tool in the current tool set
criteria.action: run the call on its own goroutine and pass the input bytes to that tool's Execute verbatim, with the RPC context as the tool's context, so that cancelling the RPC cancels the tool and tools.Run kills the command's process group. Data and Metadata are marshalled with encoding/json, and a nil or empty value is sent as empty bytes
criteria.contract: CallResponse with ok, data, error, detail, metadata and text from the tool's ToolResult

criteria.condition: a Call names a tool that the current set lacks or arrives before any Tools RPC, the tool's Data or Metadata fails to marshal, or the tool panics
criteria.action: answer with a failed tool result instead of an RPC error and keep serving
criteria.contract: CallResponse with ok=false and error `unknown_tool` (detail lists the available tool names), `marshal_failed`, or `panic` respectively; the RPC status is OK

criteria.condition: a SyncTar RPC completes successfully while a tool set is configured
criteria.action: rebuild the tool set with the same options, so that find_symbol and find_references see the synced files. Calls already in flight finish on the previous set

criteria.condition: the TTL given at construction has elapsed since the agent started
criteria.action: stop serving and cancel the context of every in-flight Call
criteria.contract: Serve returns a non-nil error whose message names the TTL

requirements.title: The agentkit-sandboxd command
requirements.rationale: The agent ships as a thin command that speaks the protocol on its stdio, so that no provider needs a network listener.

criteria.action: accept the flags --workdir (default /workspace), --ttl (a time.Duration, default 1h) and --version, and build the agent service from --workdir, --ttl and os.Environ() verbatim as the tool environment

criteria.condition: agentkit-sandboxd is run with --version
criteria.action: print the agent version and the protocol version without serving
criteria.contract: stdout contains the agent version and `1.0`; exit status 0

criteria.condition: --ttl is zero or negative, or the command line has another usage error
criteria.action: exit without serving
criteria.contract: non-zero exit status and a one-line message on stderr

criteria.condition: agentkit-sandboxd starts without --version and its flags are valid
criteria.action: point os.Stdout at stderr before serving, then serve the Agent service as one HTTP/2 connection on a net.Conn made of stdin and stdout, opening no listening socket

criteria.condition: the host closes its end of the stdio connection
criteria.action: stop serving and exit
criteria.contract: exit status 0

criteria.condition: the agent fails to start (for example, --workdir does not exist) or the TTL expires
criteria.action: exit
criteria.contract: non-zero exit status and a one-line message on stderr naming the cause

criteria.action: build with CGO_ENABLED=0 for linux/amd64, linux/arm64, darwin/arm64 and windows/amd64, and build on the host with cgo enabled

requirements.title: Attach, handshake and lifetime
requirements.rationale: One implementation of Sandbox for every provider gives every provider the same version check, failure classification and state machine.

criteria.condition: a provider attaches to an agent through a net.Conn
criteria.action: open a gRPC client with grpc.NewClient using MaxMessageBytes as the call send and receive limits, insecure transport credentials, and a context dialer that returns the given connection on its first invocation and an error on every later one, so that it never redials. The Sandbox implementation is written against a gRPC client connection plus per-call outgoing metadata

criteria.condition: the agent's Hello reports a ProtocolMajor different from sandbox.ProtocolMajor
criteria.action: refuse the sandbox and run the provider's destroy step
criteria.contract: Create returns a nil Sandbox and an error for which errors.Is(err, ErrProtocol) is true and whose message contains both the agent's and the host's protocol versions

criteria.condition: the agent's Hello reports the host's ProtocolMajor and any ProtocolMinor
criteria.action: accept the sandbox; Spec() returns the effective spec with CheckSpec's defaults applied and Workdir set to the workspace root the agent reported, and Agent() returns the Hello facts
criteria.contract: Create returns a live Sandbox and nil

criteria.condition: an RPC fails while the host context is still live
criteria.action: treat InvalidArgument, FailedPrecondition, NotFound and Unimplemented as deliberate refusals that leave the sandbox live. Treat any other status, or a malformed response, as a transport failure that makes the sandbox unavailable
criteria.contract: a deliberate refusal is returned as an error and the sandbox stays live; an Unimplemented error's message names the agent's protocol version; a transport failure returns an error matching ErrUnavailable

criteria.condition: the context passed to Create is cancelled after Create has returned
criteria.action: keep the sandbox live, because that context bounds creation only and not the sandbox's lifetime

criteria.condition: the effective TTL elapses since creation, or the agent ends
criteria.action: mark the sandbox unavailable and, at the TTL, destroy it through a host-side timer

criteria.condition: Close is called on a sandbox
criteria.action: on the first call, cancel the TTL timer, close the connection and run the provider's destroy step, then mark the sandbox closed
criteria.contract: the first Close returns the first error from those steps, or nil; every later Close returns nil

criteria.condition: the sandbox is unavailable or closed
criteria.action: answer Tools, Sync and Export without making any RPC
criteria.contract: an error matching ErrUnavailable when the sandbox is unavailable, and an error matching ErrClosed when it is closed

requirements.title: Proxy tool definitions
requirements.rationale: A proxy promises the model the agent's behaviour under the host's schemas, so the definitions must be the host's own and must match the agent's exactly.

criteria.condition: Sandbox.Tools(ctx, opts) is called on a live sandbox
criteria.action: send the Tools RPC with opts, build the host's own tools.All definitions with the same options over a throwaway workspace, and compare the agent's tool names (same set, same order) and per-tool digests with the host's
criteria.contract: on a match, returns one proxy tool for each tool that tools.All returns, in tools.All order, and nil

criteria.action: for any two core.Tool values, return equal digests exactly when their name, description, input schema JSON, output schema JSON, prompt guidelines, Builtin flag and execution mode are all equal. A single function, shared by the host and the agent, computes the digest as SHA-256 over those fields

criteria.condition: the agent's tool names, their order, or any per-tool digest differ from the host's
criteria.action: refuse to return proxy tools; the sandbox stays live
criteria.contract: Tools returns nil and an error for which errors.Is(err, ErrToolMismatch) is true, whose message names each differing tool and both the agent version and the host version

criteria.action: copy Name, Description, InputSchema, OutputSchema, PromptGuidelines, Builtin, ExecutionMode, PrepareArguments and Label from the host's tools.All value, so that InputSchema and OutputSchema marshal to JSON byte-identical to the tools.All counterpart's. Handler and ReachableTools are left nil, Terminating false, and Execute set to the remote call, keeping no Execute closure from the host's tools.All

criteria.condition: Sandbox.Tools is called a second time with options equal to the first call's
criteria.action: return proxy tools equivalent to the first call's, with the same names, order and definition fields
criteria.contract: returns the tool slice and nil

criteria.condition: Sandbox.Tools is called a second time with options different from the first call's
criteria.action: refuse without reconfiguring the agent
criteria.contract: returns nil and an error for which errors.Is(err, ErrToolsConfigured) is true

criteria.action: allow concurrent Execute calls from multiple goroutines on the same or different proxy tools without serialising them on the host and without data races under `go test -race`, so that each call receives its own result

requirements.title: Proxy tool execution
requirements.rationale: A remote call must look to the driver exactly like a local one, and treat the agent's output as untrusted under the project's wire invariant.

criteria.condition: a proxy tool's Execute(ctx, input) is called on a live sandbox and the agent answers with a well-formed response
criteria.action: send input verbatim as the CallRequest input, then build a core.ToolResult with OK, Error, Detail and Text copied verbatim. Data is decoded with json.Decoder.UseNumber so that re-encoding it yields the agent's bytes, Metadata is decoded into a *core.ToolMetadata (nil when empty), Terminate is false and Blocks is nil
criteria.contract: returns that core.ToolResult

criteria.condition: the CallRequest for input would exceed MaxMessageBytes
criteria.action: return without making an RPC and leave the sandbox live
criteria.contract: core.ToolResult with OK=false and Error `arguments_too_large`

criteria.condition: the response's non-empty Data fails wire.Guard with wire.Limits{} or is not a JSON object, or its non-empty Metadata fails wire.Guard or does not decode into core.ToolMetadata
criteria.action: treat the response as a transport failure and make the sandbox unavailable
criteria.contract: core.ToolResult with OK=false, Error `sandbox_unavailable` and a Detail naming the malformed field

criteria.condition: the host context ends before or during the call
criteria.action: return at once and leave the sandbox live. The agent's tool context is cancelled with the RPC, so the process group the call started inside the sandbox is killed
criteria.contract: core.ToolResult equal to core.ErrResult("aborted", "Operation aborted"); no process started by the call remains

criteria.condition: the call meets a transport failure
criteria.action: make the sandbox unavailable without retrying or reconnecting
criteria.contract: core.ToolResult with OK=false, Error `sandbox_unavailable` and a Detail naming the cause; every later call on any proxy tool of that sandbox returns Error `sandbox_unavailable` without an RPC

criteria.condition: Execute is called after the sandbox has been closed
criteria.action: return without making an RPC
criteria.contract: core.ToolResult with OK=false, Error `sandbox_unavailable` and Detail `sandbox closed`

criteria.condition: the agent answers a call with error `unknown_tool`
criteria.action: pass the response through as the call's result and leave the sandbox live
criteria.contract: core.ToolResult with OK=false, Error `unknown_tool` and the agent's Detail

requirements.title: Tar sync and export
requirements.rationale: Tar, using only the standard library, is how this foundation puts a project into a sandbox and gets files out, and the same entry rules apply in both directions.

criteria.condition: a Tar.Path or an Export path is absolute, or contains a `..` component after path.Clean
criteria.action: refuse the operation before any byte moves; `""` and `.` both name the workspace root and are accepted
criteria.contract: Sync or Export returns a non-nil error naming the path, makes no RPC, and leaves the sandbox live

criteria.action: for any tar stream, accept only regular files, directories, and symlinks whose target, resolved against the link's own directory, stays inside the target directory. Refuse an absolute entry name, an entry name with a `..` component, hard links, character and block devices, FIFOs, any other entry type, a symlink whose target leaves the target directory, and an entry whose path resolves through an existing symlink to a location outside. Clear the setuid, setgid and sticky bits of every accepted entry. The same function applies on the agent's extraction and on the host's export validation

perform every extraction write through an os.Root opened at the target directory, so that no write follows a symlink out of it, including an entry written through a symlink extracted earlier from the same stream

criteria.condition: Sync(ctx, Tar{R, Path, Replace}) is called on a live sandbox and every entry is accepted
criteria.system: sandbox attach package and agent service
criteria.action: stream a start chunk carrying Path and Replace, then R in data chunks of at most 1 MiB. The agent extracts entries as the bytes arrive and creates missing parent directories; with Replace, it first removes the existing contents of Path and keeps Path (or creates it when absent)
criteria.contract: returns SyncResult{Files: number of regular files written, Bytes: bytes of file content written} and nil

criteria.condition: the synced stream contains an entry that the entry rules refuse, or a malformed entry
criteria.action: stop the sync at that entry and keep the entries already extracted; the sandbox stays live
criteria.contract: the agent returns gRPC InvalidArgument naming the entry; Sync returns an error for which errors.Is(err, ErrUnsafeArchive) is true and whose message names the entry

criteria.condition: reading R returns an error, or ctx is cancelled, during Sync
criteria.action: cancel the SyncTar RPC and leave the sandbox live
criteria.contract: Sync returns a non-nil error wrapping the read error or ctx.Err()

criteria.condition: Export(ctx, path, TarOut{W}) is called on a live sandbox for an existing path
criteria.system: agent service and sandbox attach package
criteria.action: have the agent archive the subtree verbatim, including hidden and ignored files, storing symlinks as symlinks without following them, skipping entry types other than regular files, directories and symlinks, and naming entries relative to path (a path naming a single file archives that file). The host then reads the stream with archive/tar, applies the entry rules, and writes each validated entry to W
criteria.contract: returns nil after W has received a tar stream of every validated entry

criteria.condition: the Export path does not exist in the workspace, or the exported stream contains an entry that the entry rules refuse
criteria.action: stop the export and leave the sandbox live
criteria.contract: for a missing path, the agent returns gRPC NotFound and Export returns a non-nil error naming the path; for a refused entry, Export returns an error for which errors.Is(err, ErrUnsafeArchive) is true and writes nothing from that entry onward to W

requirements.title: The local provider
requirements.rationale: An in-process provider exercises the production protocol and transport in tests, without claiming any isolation that it lacks.

criteria.action: report Capabilities{Provider: "local", Isolation: IsolationNone, Network: [NetworkUnrestricted]}, with no boundable Resources field, Image false, Workdir false, and Notes stating that tools run in the embedder's process with its privileges

criteria.condition: Create receives a Spec with Network.Mode NetworkNone (including the zero Spec) or NetworkAllowlist, any non-zero Resources field, a non-empty Image, a non-empty Workdir, or any Spec.Provider key
criteria.action: refuse through CheckSpec, or through its own option check for Spec.Provider keys, before creating any directory
criteria.contract: Create returns a nil Sandbox and an error naming provider "local" and the offending field or key; for capability refusals, errors.Is(err, ErrUnsupported) is true; no directory is created under agentkit-sandbox-local

criteria.condition: Create accepts a Spec
criteria.action: create <os.TempDir()>/agentkit-sandbox-local/<id>/, where <id> is 16 random hex characters, containing workspace/, home/ and tmp/ each with mode 0700, and a marker file recording the creating process's pid, the labels, the creation time and the TTL
criteria.contract: Create returns a live Sandbox whose ID() is <id> and whose Agent().Workdir is the resolved workspace/ path

criteria.action: give the agent the environment Spec.Env, plus PATH, LANG and TERM copied from the host for each one Spec.Env lacks, plus HOME set to the sandbox's home/ and TMPDIR set to the sandbox's tmp/
run the agent service in-process over two os.Pipe pairs wrapped by the same net.Conn adapter that agentkit-sandboxd uses, and apply no confinement of any kind

criteria.condition: Close is called on a local sandbox
criteria.action: stop the in-process agent and remove the sandbox's directory
criteria.contract: Close returns nil and <os.TempDir()>/agentkit-sandbox-local/<id> no longer exists

criteria.condition: Reap(ctx) is called
criteria.action: remove every sandbox directory under agentkit-sandbox-local whose marker names a pid that is not running (checked with signal 0 on Unix). On a platform with no liveness probe, remove nothing
criteria.contract: returns the ids it removed and nil; directories of running pids are untouched

criteria.condition: a test uses the local provider's unexported or internal connection-cut hook
criteria.action: close the pipe connection between host and agent at that moment, including while a Call is in flight, so that the host sees a transport failure

requirements.title: Integration, dependencies and build gates
requirements.rationale: The driver, guard and code mode must work over proxy tools unchanged, and the new dependencies and code must stay within the module's existing gates.

criteria.condition: agentkit.New is called with proxy tools that include execute or run_command and a nil Config.Guard
criteria.action: refuse the configuration exactly as it does for local shell tools
criteria.contract: returns a nil *Agent and an error for which errors.Is(err, core.ErrUnguardedExecute) is true

criteria.condition: a provider/faux-driven run through agentkit.New executes a code-mode script over proxy read_file, search_files and execute, and Config.Guard blocks one of the script's calls
criteria.system: agentkit driver with codemode over proxy tools
criteria.action: return a tool error to the script for the blocked call and complete its other calls in the sandbox
criteria.contract: the script receives an error result for the blocked call; every other nested call returns ok; every nested call's tool execution events name the code_mode call as parent

criteria.action: make every file effect of a proxy tool (write_file, edit_file, execute and run_command writing a file) land under the sandbox's workspace and nothing under the host process's working directory

hold the spec 06 conformance case table (each built-in tool's success Data validated against its OutputSchema, and its documented error codes). The tools tests run it against tools.All with unchanged outcomes, and the sandbox tests run it against proxy tools over local, where every case passes

list google.golang.org/grpc v1.64.1 and google.golang.org/protobuf v1.36.11 as direct requirements and gain no other direct requirement, keep golang.org/x/net indirect, leave the output of `go list -m all` unchanged, and approve both modules in internal/policy approvedDeps with a reason each

pass the cross-target gate (build and vet for linux/amd64, linux/arm64, darwin/arm64 and windows/amd64 with cgo off, and a host build with cgo on) and TS-12-14's budget of 20,000 non-test Go lines with the generated sandboxpb code counted, so that `make check` exits 0

place all new production code under sandbox/, have only examples/sandbox and test helpers under internal/ import sandbox packages from outside that tree, and leave every exported identifier of the agentkit, core, tools and codemode packages unchanged

criteria.condition: `go test ./examples/sandbox` runs
criteria.action: run the example program against local.Unisolated() and provider/faux offline, with no network access and no API key
criteria.contract: the example's main_test.go passes and the program exits 0

execution_paths.title: An embedder creates a local sandbox, syncs a project, and runs a proxy tool

steps.action: calls local.Unisolated().Create(ctx, Spec{Network: Network{Mode: NetworkUnrestricted}})
runs CheckSpec, creates agentkit-sandbox-local/<id>/ with workspace/, home/, tmp/ and the marker, and starts the agent service in-process over two os.Pipe pairs
opens the one-shot gRPC client over the pipe conn, calls Hello, checks ProtocolMajor and starts the TTL timer
calls Sync(ctx, Tar{R: projectTar}) and then Tools(ctx, ToolOptions{})
extracts the tar into workspace/ under the entry rules, builds tools.All with the explicit environment, and returns names and digests
compares the digests with the host's own tools.All and returns eleven proxy tools in tools.All order
calls the proxy read_file Execute with JSON input naming a synced file
runs read_file in the workspace and returns ok, Data, Metadata and Text as JSON bytes
guards and decodes Data and Metadata and returns a core.ToolResult with the file's content
calls Close, and the local provider stops the agent and removes the sandbox directory

execution_paths.title: A faux-driven code-mode run over proxy tools has one call blocked by the guard

steps.action: creates a local sandbox, syncs a tree, gets proxy tools, wraps read_file, search_files and execute with codemode.New, and builds agentkit.New with provider/faux and a Config.Guard that blocks one command
returns a code_mode tool call whose script calls read_file, search_files and execute twice
runs the code_mode tool, which routes each nested call through the nested caller, guard and event pipeline
blocks one execute call, and the script receives a tool error for it
sends each allowed nested call to the agent over Call and returns its result to the script
emits tool execution events for every nested call naming the code_mode call as parent, and finishes the run with the script's output

execution_paths.title: A cancelled proxy execute call aborts and kills its sandbox process

steps.action: calls the proxy execute Execute with a long-running command under a context it then cancels
sees the host context end and returns core.ErrResult("aborted", "Operation aborted") at once
receives the cancelled RPC context, and tools.Run kills the command's process group
calls another proxy tool on the same sandbox, which still succeeds

execution_paths.title: A transport failure makes the sandbox sticky-unavailable

steps.action: starts a proxy execute call and uses the local provider's connection-cut hook while the call is in flight
classifies the RPC error as a transport failure and marks the sandbox unavailable
returns sandbox_unavailable with a detail naming the cause
calls another proxy tool and Sync on the same sandbox, and gets sandbox_unavailable and ErrUnavailable without any RPC

execution_paths.title: An embedder exports a workspace subtree as a validated tar

steps.action: calls Export(ctx, "out", TarOut{W: buf}) on a live local sandbox after a proxy write_file created out/result.txt
archives the out subtree verbatim, with names relative to out and symlinks stored as symlinks, and streams it as TarChunk messages
reads the stream with archive/tar, applies the entry rules to each entry, and writes each validated entry to W
reads buf with archive/tar and finds result.txt with the content the tool wrote

execution_paths.title: The agentkit-sandboxd binary serves the protocol on its stdio

steps.action: builds sandbox/cmd/agentkit-sandboxd and starts it with --workdir <tempdir> --ttl 1m, holding pipes to its stdin and stdout
points os.Stdout at stderr and serves the Agent service as one HTTP/2 connection over stdin and stdout
attaches over a net.Conn built from the child's pipes, calls Hello and Tools, and runs a proxy list_files call
closes the connection, and agentkit-sandboxd exits with status 0
